title: Integrate accepted photo refs with CheckIn and Bus photo_ref_attached publication
verify: Accepted photo refs attach to CheckIn after catalog/file/manifest refs exist
Bus photo_ref_attached event contains refs, scope, sha256, trust label, and redaction status
Bus payload excludes raw image bytes, secrets, UI text, and unauthorized Plant data
evidence_required: CheckIn photo integration and BusEventEnvelope test output
constraints: Publish after accepted catalog/file/manifest refs exist
Bus carries refs and metadata, not raw image bytes
Photo artifacts cannot mutate runtime Plant state or dataset trainability
invariants: Agent Chat Bus contains only validated, permission-scoped, adapter-produced events
UI Feed and raw chat cannot enter Bus as agent context
Secrets and unauthorized Plant/Farm data are forbidden Bus content
